Contact: +91 90621 50656 Bharat Sevashram to Gaya Station: 15 Min Walking Guide (NO Rickshaw Needed!)
This vlog provides a step-by-step walking guide from the main gate of Bharat Sevashram Sangha directly to Gaya Station. You'll see key landmarks and turns, ensuring you navigate the streets of Gaya with confidence.
Perfect for budget-conscious travelers and pilgrims visiting Gaya for Pind Daan, this video eliminates the stress of finding transportation and helps you reach the station quickly and efficiently.
